At Jackson Hole, Powell opened the door to a September cut, prioritizing rising labor-market downside risk over inflation; CME odds of a Sept cut ~80-90 pct, with markets pricing 100-125 bp of cuts through year-end (fed funds toward ~4.25 pct). Rates: 10Y yield fell to ~4.22-4.24 pct (from ~4.55 pct in July). USD: DXY soft, below its 200DMA. Net: the dominant forces (Fed easing into record equity highs + confirmed AI earnings strength + crypto uptrend) outweigh the oil risk -> RISK-ON, but measured: keep a full cash buffer as optionality against the Hormuz tail. NAV 110,791.61 USD, +10.83 pct vs July 20's 99,965.18 and +10.79 pct since 100k inception -- ahead of the ~33 pct CAGR pace. Portfolio actions today: NONE. The regime upgrade lifts the crypto sleeve cap from 20 pct to 35 pct, so the sleeve at 22.6 pct of NAV (drifted up on the crypto rally) needs NO trim -- the guardrail is satisfied without a trade. MSFT is the largest position at 17.06 pct NAV (drifted above the 15 pct entry cap on the rally but below the ~20 pct drift-trim trigger -- hold, no add); BTC 16.08 pct similarly. Cash 12.58 pct, well above the 5 pct floor. No invalidation level is close to breached. With equities at record highs and crypto in 'Greed', there is no discounted entry to chase -- adding here would be buying strength, not edge. HOLD day, zero trades.
